info.name: Knowledge Base API Management
info.description: API-only delivery: select requests interactively; do not run destructive operations as a blind collection runner. Set credentials in a local/private environment; never export real keys. Job state is read from backend. Poll active jobs every 2s, stop at terminal state; reduce polling when hidden. Review manual overwrite and applyAll explicitly. There is no generated answer or user administration.
